title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, faithful empirical C2--C7 camera geometry, exact cutoff-tail jets, and the finite-to-limit transverse-energy architecture. Version 0.13.0 adds a kernel-checked microscopic coercivity bridge: exact moving-clock reoptimization, primitive quotient estimates, and concrete six-camera residual, corrected first-jet, pairing, energy, and Schur-coefficient reductions. The abstract eventual-positivity step now requires only a strictly positive phase floor together with vanishing perturbation channels, rather than the historical threshold phaseFloor > 4. The release does not promote the remaining uniform finite-jet bounds, denominator floors, compact-region coverage, numerical evidence, or readout-domain equivalences to an unconditional confinement theorem.
